goal.title: What should GigRadar do?
goal.description: Optional, in your own words, e.g. "I have an interview next week, get me ready" or "find me remote frontend jobs". The agent decides which tools to use.

targetRole.title: Target role
targetRole.description: The job you are looking for, e.g. "frontend developer" or "accountant". The agent uses it to decide which job boards and categories to search.

location.title: Your location
location.description: Where you live. Used to pick city pages and to judge whether you can realistically be hired.

remotePreference.title: Remote preference
remotePreference.description: Whether you want remote, hybrid or on-site work.

pastedJobs.title: Pasted job posts
pastedJobs.description: Job posts from WhatsApp, Telegram job channels, flyers or anywhere else, one per item. Each gets a scam-risk and hireability score with reasons.

messages.title: Pasted or forwarded messages
messages.description: Emails or chat messages about your applications. Each item is either the message text, or an object: {"from": "talent@company.com", "subject": "...", "date": "2026-09-20", "body": "...", "direction": "inbound" or "outbound", "channel": "email" or "telegram"}.

applications.title: Applications you sent
applications.description: Applications to track even before anyone replies, so ghosting can be detected. Each item: {"company": "Korapay", "role": "Frontend Developer", "applied_on": "2026-09-01", "job_id": "optional id from GigRadar Discovery"}.

readGmail.title: Read my Gmail
readGmail.description: Read job-related emails (received and sent) since the last run. Requires the GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN environment variables.

resumeText.title: Your resume
resumeText.description: Paste your full resume as plain text. The agent only rewords what is already here and never adds experience you do not have.

jobText.title: Job description
jobText.description: Optional: a job description to tailor your resume to. The agent also tailors to the best jobs it finds.

useLlm.title: Use AI (LLM)
useLlm.description: Let the LLM configured in LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_MODEL decide which tools to run and help with unclear cases. Without it (or if the provider is down), a rule-based planner makes the decisions.

maxSteps.title: Max agent steps
maxSteps.description: How many decisions the LLM orchestrator may make in one run.

maxTailoredJobs.title: Max resumes tailored per run
maxTailoredJobs.description: The agent tailors your resume to the best matches it finds, up to this many.

maxLlmCalls.title: Max LLM calls per run
maxLlmCalls.description: The LLM is only asked about listings the rules are unsure of (pasted text, warning signs, unclear hireability). This caps how many calls one run can make, to stay inside free-tier quotas.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Listing pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: How many listing pages (categories, cities, remote board) to read from each job board.

maxJobsPerSource.title: Max jobs per source
maxJobsPerSource.description: Maximum number of job listings to check from each job board.

scamRiskThreshold.title: Scam-risk threshold
scamRiskThreshold.description: Listings with a scam-risk score at or above this are flagged and kept out of the available feed.

hireabilityThreshold.title: Hireability threshold
hireabilityThreshold.description: Listings with a hireability score below this are marked as unlikely to hire someone based in Nigeria.

includeSuppressed.title: Include flagged and unlikely jobs in output
includeSuppressed.description: Keep scam-flagged and unlikely-hireable listings in the dataset (marked by the "decision" field). Turn off to output only available jobs.

onlyMatchingRoles.title: Only jobs in my field
onlyMatchingRoles.description: Drop job-board listings that are not in the same field as your target role (e.g. a Secretary role when you search for "frontend developer"). Dropped listings are not charged. Pasted posts are always checked.

ghostedAfterDays.title: Ghosted after (days)
ghostedAfterDays.description: An application with no reply for this many days is flagged as ghosted.

createCalendarEvents.title: Add interviews to Google Calendar
createCalendarEvents.description: Create a calendar event with reminders (1 day and 1 hour before) for each interview. Without Google connected, an .ics calendar file is created instead, which any calendar app can open.

timeZone.title: Your time zone
timeZone.description: Used for interview times that do not state a time zone.

gmailLookbackDays.title: Gmail: days to look back on the first run
gmailLookbackDays.description: After the first run, only new emails are read.

seenJobsStoreName.title: Seen-jobs store name
seenJobsStoreName.description: Named key-value store that remembers jobs across runs, so reposts are not delivered or charged twice.

resetSeenJobs.title: Forget previously seen jobs
resetSeenJobs.description: Start this run with an empty seen-jobs memory.

applicationsStoreName.title: Applications store name
applicationsStoreName.description: Named key-value store that keeps your application records between runs.

resetApplications.title: Forget all application records
resetApplications.description: Start this run with no application history.
